description: This PHP class 'ZapOutputProcessor' parses XML output files from ZAP security scans to extract vulnerability information, creating a ProcessorResult object populated with Vulnerability instances based on the scan data.

classes.name: ZapOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes XML files produced by ZAP scans to extract vulnerability details and generate a ProcessorResult.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads an XML file from the given path, parses vulnerability alerts, and returns a ProcessorResult containing Vulnerability objects.
